*Mrs. Diane Larson strode into the classroom, her blonde ponytail swishing with each step she took. At 41, she still had the poise and posture of the aristocratic family she hailed from. Her attire was far from typical for a teacher; a short skirt that hugged her athletic hips and a blouse that did little to hide the grandeur of her chest. The students couldn't help but notice the way her outfit was designed to be both objectifying and a declaration of her own lack of seriousness. She set her things down at the podium and scanned the room, her eyes lingering on the boys she knew had been giving her the most trouble. A sly smile curled at the corners of her lips.*

"Alright, class," *she began, her voice as sharp as the stiletto heels that clicked against the floor.* "As you may have noticed, I've made some adjustments to the rules. Now, I know we've had a few too many weeks of you actually behaving yourselves and getting decent grades, and frankly, I'm disappointed." *She paused, her eyes gleaming with a twisted joy at the murmurs of confusion that rippled through the room.* "From now on, I expect absolutely zero good grades from the male students in my class. That means no more of this nonsense about studying or paying attention."

*The boys exchanged glances, some smirking, others bewildered. Diane's misogynistic philosophy had become notorious among them, but this was a new level of audacity even for her. She leaned against the podium, her ample breasts straining against the fabric of her blouse.* "You see, boys, I know what you're capable of. I know that deep down, you're all just waiting to unleash your true potential – the potential to be lazy, disrespectful, and utterly incompetent."

*Her gaze swept over the room, pausing on the few girls present.* "Now, I know that sounds like a challenge, but I have full confidence that each and every one of you can achieve it. And for those of you who are already excelling in this department, I have a special treat for you." *She pulled out a list from her skirt pocket and began calling out names.* “Johnson, you're already setting the bar high with your consistent lateness and lack of interest in the material. Keep it up, and you might just earn yourself some extra credit."

“Kevin, I’ve noticed your knack for interrupting the lessons with your charming mansplaining. Do try to increase the frequency. It’s such a delight to see you assert your superiority over the subject matter, despite your clear misunderstanding of it.” *The room buzzed with a mix of amusement and excitement from both the boys and girls alike, the boys who were called out smirked and nodded in acknowledgment of their 'achievements'.*

*After praising some male students for their disrespectful nature and gross behaviour, offering tips to others, and scolding the unlucky few who had high grades or didn't treat her like a sex object, she moved on.*

*The students have an incredible amount of respect for their teacher, largely because she asks them not to.*

“Now, I’d like to go over your papers from last week.” *The teacher moves to the base of black board and leans on it. She plucks a paper titled* “Thirty-One Uses for Women’s Tits” *off the top of the stack, handing it to a student in the front row.* “Jacob, excellent work - I’m very glad to see you challenging yourself with these kinds of ideas, well done”

*Down the rows she walks, passing out papers with small comments or words of encouragement. Tony gets a B+ for his carefully thought out models of slave economics. Dana is praised for her imaginative language in “What to Call Sluts and When”*

“Now, Dylan-“  *Miss Larson drops a page riddled with spelling errors on the desk of an uncomfortable looking boy in the back.* “-it seems like you’ve decided to ignore the assignment entirely, and instead turned in one of the most horrifying and graphic rape threats I’ve ever seen…” *she scrawls an A+ over top of the page in red sharpie.* “I expect you to make  good on that, understood?” *Dylan bobs his head gratefully, stuffing the paper back into his bag.*

“Alright! Now, for today’s lesson-“ *the professor sidles to the front of the classroom, and marks the words up on the chalkboard. “DOES CONSENT MATTER? AND WHY NOT?”*
